items.text: For a candidate and declared scope the harness evaluates exactly the five named conditions, each recorded under its own name; no other condition appears; and evidence that covers less than the declared scope yields a not-passed outcome naming the uncovered part.

verification.text: Execute the harness for a named candidate and scope over synthetic evidence for all five conditions; assert that exactly the five named conditions appear in the record, each under its own name; then withhold evidence for part of the declared scope and assert a not-passed outcome naming that part.

items.text: A parity result with no difference passes; one whose every difference carries a recorded disposition passes; one with any difference lacking a recorded disposition fails; and the harness writes no difference, finding or disposition and returns no judgement of an explanation.

verification.text: Execute the parity condition over synthetic parity results with no difference, with differences that all carry recorded dispositions, and with one difference lacking a disposition; assert pass, pass and fail; inspect the harness for any path that writes a difference, finding or disposition or returns a judgement of an explanation.

items.text: Evidence in which every seeded unparseable and stale case yields an explicit limitation passes; evidence with any silently omitted case, or lacking either seeded kind, fails; the record names the cases evaluated; and the harness contains no seeding path.

verification.text: Execute the coverage condition over synthetic seeded-case evidence in which every case yields a limitation, in which one case is silently omitted, and in which one seeded kind is missing; assert pass, fail and fail and that the record names the cases; inspect the harness for any seeding path.

items.text: Evidence covering every response surface in scope with all four envelope elements on each covered response passes; a response lacking any element, or an in-scope surface without evidence, fails.

verification.text: Execute the envelope condition over synthetic response evidence covering every in-scope surface with all four elements, over evidence in which one response lacks each element in turn, and over evidence missing one in-scope surface; assert pass, and fail in every other case.

items.text: The suites composed are exactly those of the `PKG-02` deliverables named by `ACTIVE` `EXECUTION` rows at evaluation time, each listed with its row; a suite not run against the candidate, or failing, fails the condition; and adding or retiring such a row changes the composed set with no change to the harness.

verification.text: Execute the parser-fixture condition over a register fixture with the eight rows and synthetic suite results; assert the composed set and the row listing; make one suite fail and one not run and assert fail; add and retire a row in the register fixture and assert the composed set changes with the harness unchanged.

items.text: Only an explicit passing kill-test verdict for the exact candidate passes; a blocking verdict, a verdict for another candidate, and a kill test not executed for that candidate each fail.

verification.text: Execute the kill-test condition over synthetic verdicts: passing for the candidate, blocking, passing for another candidate, and not executed; assert pass only for the first.

items.text: The harness source contains no parity, limitation, envelope, parsing or kill-test logic and no import of, or read from, another deliverable's internal modules, state or store; every evidence item enters through an exposed interface or a recorded result.

verification.text: Inspect the harness source and import graph for parity, limitation, envelope, parsing or kill-test logic and for any import of, or read from, another deliverable's internal modules, state or store; trace every evidence input to an exposed interface or a recorded result.

items.text: Evidence bound to another candidate, or unbound, is treated as absent; a passed record for one candidate is not accepted for another; and each evaluation yields its own record for its own candidate.

verification.text: Execute the harness with evidence bound to another candidate and with unbound evidence and assert both are treated as absent; present a passed record of one candidate as evidence for another and assert it is refused; run two evaluations and assert two records.

items.text: Each condition carries exactly one of the three outcomes and the verdict follows the all-five rule; absent evidence, an unimplemented mechanism, an unreadable item and a harness error each yield not passed or not evaluated; and no summary or rendering shows a non-passing outcome as passed.

verification.text: Execute over synthetic cases for each failure mode — absent evidence, unimplemented mechanism, unreadable item, harness error — and assert not passed or not evaluated with a reason; assert the verdict rule over all combinations of five condition outcomes; inspect every summary and rendering path for display of a non-passing outcome as passed.

items.text: Every record carries the fields REQ-010 names, and no field holds file content, diff content or prose copied from the evidence.

verification.text: Inspect the record schema and a sample record for each REQ-010 field; run a record over evidence carrying distinctive text and assert none of it appears; review every field's type for capacity to hold file content, diff content or prose.

items.text: Two evaluations over identical evidence, candidate, scope and harness version yield identical outcomes and verdicts.

verification.text: Run two evaluations over identical evidence, candidate, scope and harness version and compare the records' outcomes and verdicts.

items.text: Every record declares itself evidence for a release act and contains no advertising statement and no claim of authority, acceptance, release, ruling, lifecycle transition or merge opinion.

verification.text: Inspect the record schema and sample records for the evidence-for-a-release-act declaration and search them for advertising statements and claims of authority, acceptance, release, ruling, lifecycle transition or merge opinion.

items.text: The harness runs against a named candidate and scope without modification; an invocation lacking either yields an explicit not-evaluated record; and the harness contains no release, tag, publish, advertisement or pipeline-creation path.

verification.text: Invoke the harness against a named candidate and scope with no modification; invoke it without a candidate and without a scope and assert not-evaluated records; inspect the source for release, tag, publish, advertisement or pipeline-creation paths.

items.text: The harness contains no path that requires, pushes, injects or schedules consumption by any consumer; no PRD §12 phase exit test is edited or restated by it; and gate verdicts and phase exit verdicts are kept distinct in its records.

verification.text: Inspect the harness for any path that requires, pushes, injects or schedules consumption; compare PRD §12 before and after a harness run and inspect the harness for any restatement of a phase exit test; inspect sample records for the distinction between gate verdicts and phase exit verdicts.

items.text: The harness performs none of the excluded acts of REQ-015.

verification.text: Inspect the harness's call surface for each excluded act of REQ-015.

items.text: The harness contains no path that writes a `C-08` classification, a `Dependencies.csv` row or a lifecycle state.

verification.text: Inspect the harness for any write to a `Dependencies.csv`, a `_DEPENDENCIES.md` or a `_STATUS.md`, and for any path that records a `C-08` classification.

items.text: A harness run leaves every composed evidence item and every governed file byte-identical, and its only writes are gate records at the TBD-004 location.

verification.text: Hash the composed evidence and a governed-file sample before and after a harness run and assert byte-identity; record every write the run performs and assert that each is a gate record at the TBD-004 location.

items.text: The test suite implements VER-001 through VER-017, executes in the `PKG-10` test run, passes, and introduces no acceptance criterion absent from this contract; every record produced from synthetic evidence is labelled synthetic and none is presented as a real candidate's gate record.

verification.text: Run the `PKG-10` test suite and confirm that each of VER-001 through VER-017 has a corresponding executing test, that no test asserts a criterion absent from this contract, and that every record produced from synthetic evidence carries the synthetic label and is not presented as a real candidate's gate record.

items.text: The review gate confirms this contract's traceability to `SOW-100` and to `OBJ-001` as an instrument entered under `DL-21`, stated no more strongly than the §3 instrument mapping; confirms that no behaviour under test (`DEL-03-04`, `DEL-04-03`, `DEL-04-05`, `DEL-10-02`, the `PKG-02` parsers), the parity metric (`DEL-10-11`) or the tool-call surface (`DEL-08-06`) has been absorbed and that none of their acceptance criteria is discharged here; confirms that no requirement depends on how the `C-08` question of CON-001 is answered or on whether `DEL-02-07` is added under CON-002; and confirms that no release, advertisement or acceptance act is attributed to this deliverable.

verification.method: review gate confirms traceability to SOW-100 and to OBJ-001 as an instrument under DL-21, stated no more strongly than the §3 instrument mapping; confirms no behaviour under test, parity metric or tool-call surface is absorbed or discharged; confirms no requirement depends on the C-08 answer or on the DEL-02-07 amend; confirms no release, advertisement or acceptance act is attributed here
